nodes.title: Fundamental Integrals & Anti-derivatives
points: Definition: ∫ f(x) dx = F(x) + c ⟺ d/dx[F(x) + c] = f(x).
Algebraic: ∫ xⁿ dx = xⁿ⁺¹/(n + 1) + c (n ≠ −1); ∫ (1/x) dx = ln|x| + c; ∫ (1/√x) dx = 2√x + c.
Exponential: ∫ eˣ dx = eˣ + c; ∫ aˣ dx = aˣ / ln a + c.
Trigonometric: ∫ sin x dx = −cos x + c; ∫ cos x dx = sin x + c; ∫ sec²x dx = tan x + c; ∫ cosec²x dx = −cot x + c; ∫ sec x tan x dx = sec x + c; ∫ cosec x cot x dx = −cosec x + c.
Linear Extension: If ∫ f(x) dx = F(x) + c, then ∫ f(ax + b) dx = (1/a) F(ax + b) + c.

formulas.label: Linear argument
formulas.expr: ∫ f(ax + b) dx = (1/a) F(ax + b) + c

nodes.title: Integration by Substitution
points: Formula: ∫ f(g(x)) g'(x) dx = ∫ f(t) dt, where t = g(x) and dt = g'(x) dx.
Master Derivative/Function Forms:
1. ∫ [f'(x) / f(x)] dx = ln|f(x)| + c (Numerator is derivative of denominator).
Integrals of Other Trig Functions:
∫ tan x dx = ln|sec x| + c = −ln|cos x| + c.
∫ cot x dx = ln|sin x| + c.
∫ sec x dx = ln|sec x + tan x| + c = ln|tan(π/4 + x/2)| + c.
∫ cosec x dx = ln|cosec x − cot x| + c = ln|tan(x/2)| + c.

nodes.title: Integrals of Special Rational Functions
points: 1. ∫ [1 / (x² + a²)] dx = (1/a) tan⁻¹(x/a) + c.
Completing Square Technique for 1 / (ax² + bx + c):
Third term to add and subtract: (½ × coefficient of x)² = (b / 2a)².
Express denominator as (x ± α)² ± β² and apply one of the three formulas above.

nodes.title: Integrals of Special Irrational Functions
points: 1. ∫ [1 / √(a² − x²)] dx = sin⁻¹(x/a) + c.
2. ∫ [1 / √(x² + a²)] dx = ln|x + √(x² + a²)| + c.
3. ∫ [1 / √(x² − a²)] dx = ln|x + √(x² − a²)| + c.
Completing the square inside square root for 1 / √(ax² + bx + c):
Factor out 'a' (if a > 0), complete square, and apply appropriate formula.
Remember: sin⁻¹(x/a) does NOT have a 1/a factor outside!

nodes.title: Integrals of Type (px + q) / (ax² + bx + c)
points: Applies to forms: ∫ [(px + q) / (ax² + bx + c)] dx and ∫ [(px + q) / √(ax² + bx + c)] dx.
Method: Express numerator as:
px + q = A · d/dx(ax² + bx + c) + B = A(2ax + b) + B.
Equate coefficients of x and constant terms to find A and B.
Split integral into two parts: Part 1 uses substitution (∫ f'/f or ∫ f'/√f); Part 2 uses completing the square.

nodes.title: Integration by Parts (LIATE Rule)
points: Formula: ∫ u v dx = u ∫ v dx − ∫ [u' · (∫ v dx)] dx.
Order of precedence for choosing 1st function 'u' (LIATE):
L = Logarithmic functions (ln x)
I = Inverse trigonometric functions (sin⁻¹x, tan⁻¹x)
A = Algebraic functions (xⁿ, x² + 1)
T = Trigonometric functions (sin x, cos x)
E = Exponential functions (eˣ, aˣ).
If only a single inverse trig or log function is present (e.g., ∫ ln x dx), take 'v = 1'.

formulas.label: Integration by parts
formulas.expr: ∫ u v dx = u ∫ v dx − ∫ [u' (∫ v dx)] dx

nodes.title: The Master Exponential Form: eˣ[f(x) + f'(x)]
points: Theorem: ∫ eˣ [f(x) + f'(x)] dx = eˣ f(x) + c.
Generalized Form: ∫ e^(kx) [k f(x) + f'(x)] dx = e^(kx) f(x) + c.
Classic Examples:
1. ∫ eˣ (tan x + sec²x) dx = eˣ tan x + c.
4. ∫ eˣ [(1 + sin x) / (1 + cos x)] dx = eˣ tan(x/2) + c.

formulas.label: Master exponential theorem
formulas.expr: ∫ eˣ [f(x) + f'(x)] dx = eˣ f(x) + c

formulas.label: Scaled exponential form
formulas.expr: ∫ e^(kx) [k f(x) + f'(x)] dx = e^(kx) f(x) + c

nodes.title: Three Special Square Root Integrals
points: 1. ∫ √(a² − x²) dx = (x/2) √(a² − x²) + (a²/2) sin⁻¹(x/a) + c.
2. ∫ √(x² + a²) dx = (x/2) √(x² + a²) + (a²/2) ln|x + √(x² + a²)| + c.
3. ∫ √(x² − a²) dx = (x/2) √(x² − a²) − (a²/2) ln|x + √(x² − a²)| + c.
Mnemonic: Every formula starts with (x/2) × (same radical), followed by ± (a²/2) × (corresponding 1/√ integral).

nodes.title: Must-Know Board Theorems & Proofs
points: Board Favourite #1: Theorem: Prove integration by parts formula: ∫ uv dx = u ∫ v dx − ∫ [u' (∫ v dx)] dx.
Board Favourite #2: Theorem: Prove ∫ [1 / (x² + a²)] dx = (1/a) tan⁻¹(x/a) + c.
Board Favourite #3: Theorem: Prove ∫ [1 / √(a² − x²)] dx = sin⁻¹(x/a) + c.
Board Favourite #4: Theorem: Prove ∫ √(a² − x²) dx = (x/2)√(a² − x²) + (a²/2) sin⁻¹(x/a) + c.
Board Favourite #5: Theorem: Prove ∫ eˣ [f(x) + f'(x)] dx = eˣ f(x) + c.

formulas.label: Parts theorem proof
formulas.expr: Integrate d/dx[u · w] where w = ∫ v dx

formulas.label: eˣ theorem proof
formulas.expr: d/dx[eˣ f(x)] = eˣ f(x) + eˣ f'(x)

nodes.title: MHT-CET Shortcuts, Cover-Up Rule & Standard Hacks
points: Heaviside Cover-Up Rule for Partial Fractions: To find A in 1 / [(x − a)(x − b)]: Cover (x − a) and put x = a ⟹ A = 1 / (a − b).
Standard Shortcut #1: ∫ [dx / (x(xⁿ + 1))] = (1/n) ln|xⁿ / (xⁿ + 1)| + c.
Standard Shortcut #2: ∫ [dx / (x(xⁿ − 1))] = (1/n) ln|(xⁿ − 1) / xⁿ| + c.
Standard Shortcut #3: ∫ e^(ax) sin(bx) dx = [e^(ax) / (a² + b²)] [a sin(bx) − b cos(bx)] + c.
Standard Shortcut #4: ∫ e^(ax) cos(bx) dx = [e^(ax) / (a² + b²)] [a cos(bx) + b sin(bx)] + c.
Trig Linear Combination Shortcut: ∫ [(a sin x + b cos x) / (c sin x + d cos x)] dx = [(ac + bd)/(c² + d²)] x + [(bc − ad)/(c² + d²)] ln|c sin x + d cos x| + c.
